entry.summary:
Author: hearts2aurie

Rating: General AudiencesLanguage: EnglishWords: 3,147Chapters: 1/1Kudos: 13

Summary: Every New Year's Eve is the same.Somewhere between disasters, patrol routes, alien invasions, and Gotham's latest attempt at self-destruction, Superman and Batman manage to exchange exactly two words: Happy New Year. It's never sentimental. Never more than a few seconds. Just another tradition carried through years of partnership. At least, that's what they tell themselves. Then, during the Justice League's annual holiday party, Wonder Woman points out that neither of them has actually celebrated New Year's in years. Before either can escape, she proposes a bet.Batman and Superman must take New Year's Eve off: no patrols, no missions, and definitely no excuses. And if they fail, they owe the entire League.Determined to prove that spending one evening together means absolutely nothing, the World's Finest heroes agree. Unfortunately, after years of missed opportunities, half-finished conversations, and annual midnight check-ins that have come to mean far more than either will admit, they discover one uninterrupted night might be more dangerous than any supervillain.Because some traditions are meant to change, and this year, for the first time, neither of them wants to spend midnight alone.
